notes.title: RADIA & MOCHIZUKI EVENT
notes.content:
Radia and Mochizuki are here! (Mochi, for her friends)

This week, you'll have the chance to play through two different events, each packed with rewards!

What’s better than one event? Two, of course!


Plus, there will be two separate gachas and exclusive offers for each girl!

Make the most of this week to gear up, because next week brings a challenging event


Yulia is no pushover, so you’ll need to come well prepared!

notes.title: EILA EVENT
notes.content:
Eila Event starts NOW!


The Eila event is here! After wrapping up August with Eile, it's now her sister's turn! During this event, you'll be able to collect shards of this character along with other rewards! 

Keep an eye on this month's events, there are some very exciting and juicy things coming!!!

notes.title: SUMMER EVENT
notes.content:
SUMMER EVENT

Summer returns to Eros Raiders!


We couldn’t say goodbye to August without one more summer event!

This time, it’s a bit different from the Radia and Pandora events, because you’ll have two events running simultaneously, each with its own unlockable H-scene!

Don’t miss the chance to unlock both Nellie’s and Marina’s H-scenes, plus grab the summer skins through the new offers.

And as if that weren’t enough, you’ll also have the chance to get the Marina Summer skin completely FREE!

Progress far enough in the events to claim all these amazing rewards!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.49 - EILE EVENT
notes.content:
Eile arrives in Eros Raiders!


Starting today, her event is available throughout this week. Take advantage of this final August event to get ready for the September events! We hope you've had a great summer and enjoyed some well deserved holidays!

This event comes packed with rewards, levels, and special offers! Power up your Raiders to prepare for everything coming next month!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.47 - CHAPTER 15 & NARASINGHAY EVENT
notes.content:
NARASINGHAY LEGENDARY EVENT & DIVINE CATS EVENT PART II
The second week of Narasinghay has begun!

Just like last week, you'll have one more week to obtain the Legendary Narasinghay, along with the chance to earn even more rewards in the second Divine Cats event!

NEW CHAPTER 15
And that's not all, this week brings Chapter 15, the newest and final chapter in the Divine Cats saga! Featuring an epic story of battle, betrayal, and romance, plus an all new exclusive HScene with Narasinghay!


All that and more, now available!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.44 - SUMMER EVENT
notes.content:
PANDORA & RADIA SUMMER EVENT

Summer is finally here, and what would summer be without some well-deserved vacation!



Dive into the summer event with the girls of Eros Raiders, and uncover a curious adventure between Radia and Pandora as you try to enjoy your holiday at a luxury resort on a remote planet!

 

Play to earn fabulous rewards—and even better, a brand-new H-scene featuring Radia and Pandora, sharing an intimate moment away from prying eyes...

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.43 - 81N4 LEGENDARY EVENT
notes.content:
POISON BUTTERFLIES EVENT   
The Poison Butterflies event has begun! 

Play and earn amazing rewards—you’ll need them for the 81N4 event! 


81N4 LEGENDARY EVENT 

The Poison Butterflies’ cyborg is here. You’ll have one week to collect her shards and unlock or upgrade her! So don’t waste any time! Go all out!!! 

Plus, as you play, you’ll unlock an exclusive 81N4 narrative and H-scene!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.42 - OPAL EVENT
notes.content:
OPAL EVENT 👑👑👑
This week we’ve got an event featuring Opal, the most stubborn and impatient of the Poison Butterflies. Don’t miss the chance to collect Epic shards of this girl. Also… you’re going to need them for something coming very soon...

notes.title: NEW CHARACTER: SAEKHMAT & NEW CHAPTER 14
notes.content:
NEW CHAPTER 14
Chapter 14 is packed with lore! Discover a new character and all their connections to the story, plus a major breakthrough that brings them closer to uncovering the traitor! Chapter 15 will mark the end of this narrative arc, get ready for battle!

NEW CHARACTER - SAEKHMAT
New character, Saekhmat! A Katsharian modified for combat, who gives your backline a brutally explosive power boost! With her area-of-effect abilities and capacity to transform armor into raw power, she fiercely destroys your enemies!

NEW HSCENE
As you complete the chapter, you will discover a curious story between the Admiral and Saekhmat, and a Hscene from a passionate night spent under the water...

SAEKHMAT EVENT
Additionally, like every Thursday, we'll have a Saekhmat event, where you can earn shards of this character as you play and uncover her full potential!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.39 - KAORI EVENT
notes.content:
DROPS - UI UPGRADE 🪨 

The Search interface is now more intuitive and provides more information about the drops!


BUGFIXING ⚙️ 

We've fixed the animation for Tiare's H-scene.


KAORI EVENT 🐭 

Kaori, the little mouse from Fantasy Rabbits, is back!

You'll have one week to play this event and get ready for Oleen's Legendary Event, which begins next week!

notes.title: NEW CHAPTER 13 + NEW CHARACTER & EVENT
notes.content:
NEW CHAPTER 13 😯
Discover in Chapter 13 the life aboard the ship for all the girls, their training routines, and the story of a new character! 
NEW CHARACTER - MAISHIPESHU 🐈
Maishipeshu, the most energetic of all the Divine Cats! An elite athlete who trains from sunrise to sunset to become the best in her field. Her unique combat skills make her an indestructible tank, and when paired correctly, she can become an impenetrable wall! 
NEW HSCENE 🔥🔥🔥
After completing Chapter 13, you will unlock an EXCLUSIVE H-SCENE featuring the Admiral and Maishipeshu in a very hot afternoon post-workout... and some lockers that will hide their desire to devour each other. 
MAISHIPESHU EVENT 😻
As usual, in addition to Chapter 13, the New Character, and the New H-scene, we’ll also have a Maishipeshu event this week, so you can get more shards and increase the power of this character to quickly include her in your teams! 
DROP SYSTEM UPGRADES 🔢
We’re improving the drop system, and you’ll hear more news from us about it in the coming weeks. In the meantime, we’ve increased the amount of materials dropped by the more difficult levels, so that the energy cost is worthwhile and you feel motivated to take on tougher challenges.

The difficulty level is now also displayed in the Search window.
